☄️：全部人都有可能吧？（指結婚）
🌽：（已猜到別人的題目是結婚）是這樣沒錯啦⋯但在現場所有這些人當中⋯有可能的只有那邊那兩人吧？⋯妳說是吧螺鈿桑？
☄️：喂不要這樣啦（突然慌張）
🌸：哪兩位？？（追問）
🐚：⋯我可以說名字嗎？

☄️：Everyone can do it right? (talking about marriage)
🌽：(already guessed other people’s questions right) well that’s true…but out of everyone here…the only two people that would have done it are the two people over there correct?…am I right Raden-san?
☄️：No it’s not like that (got nervous suddenly)
🌸：Which two?? (shows interest)
🐚：…Am I allowed to call the names?
